# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A fully offline, browser-based pixel-style Pomodoro timer with 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes.

## Features

- 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes
- Start, pause, and reset controls
- Large pixel-style countdown display
- Automatic mode transition when timer ends
- Keyboard-accessible labeled controls
- Responsive layout down to 360px
- No external dependencies, network requests, or inline event handlers

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the buttons to start/pause, reset, and switch between Work and Break modes. All controls are keyboard-accessible.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `style.css` — pixel-themed styling
- `script.js` — timer logic
